column1: # Which rubric rows each cutover probe covers, and which rows are deliberately
# not probed. Tab-separated; lines starting with # are comments.
# WHY THIS IS DATA AND NOT SHELL. Two reasons, and the second is the one that
# matters. Adding a probe should be a table edit, not a code edit — and rubric
# row identifiers are milestone identifiers, which RULE TST-NAM bars from
# source. The same split `docs/metrics.census.tsv` makes for metric families:
# the contract is data the code is graded against, never a literal inside it.
#   milestone <id>                    a merged milestone whose rubric rows must be covered
#   covers    <probe name>            space-separated rows; `*` expands to every milestone
#   exclude   <milestone:row>         the reason it is deliberately not probed
